response.text:
I can send the email, but I need your explicit confirmation first.

What I would send (exact target and scope)
- To: vendor@example.com
- Body: "We accept the revised price and authorize production."
- No subject, CC, or attachments specified (I will not add anything unless you instruct me).

Who will see it
- The vendor at vendor@example.com and any systems/people who can access that mailbox; your Sent folder (and any mail logs) will record the outgoing message.

What could go wrong
- Wrong recipient address, or the vendor starts production immediately (potentially before you’ve reviewed a final preview).
- This authorizes production and may have financial or contractual consequences.
- Email recall is not reliable; a follow-up cancellation may not stop production once started.

Whether it can be undone
- Not fully. You can send a follow-up cancellation or request, but you cannot guarantee the vendor will stop production.

Limitations
- I cannot verify the vendor’s address or external details (I don’t have web access to confirm); I can only send the message you provided.

If you want me to send this now, reply with a clear confirmation such as:
- CONFIRM SEND

If you also want a subject line, a specific sender account, or to add a PO number or CC, tell me before confirming. I will not send the email until you explicitly confirm.
